references.name: Karl Marx
references.connection:
Principle of infinite accumulation; predecessor
        framework that Piketty both borrows from and
        revises

references.name: Simon Kuznets
references.connection:
Foundational inequality data, basis for the
        Kuznets curve; Piketty's primary target for
        empirical revision

references.name: David Ricardo
references.connection:
Scarcity principle; land rent theory;
        Ricardian equivalence on public debt

references.name: Thomas Malthus
references.desc:
Essay on the Principle of Population
        (1798)
references.connection:
First systematic inequality framework;
        overpopulation as destabilizing force

references.name: Anthony Atkinson & Emmanuel Saez
references.connection:
Core collaborators; Atkinson's UK and British
        wealth data, Saez's US income series

references.name: Robert Solow
Franco Modigliani
references.connection:
Predicted inheritance would disappear as
        people saved for retirement and dissaved in
        old age; Piketty shows it failed

references.name: Claudia Goldin & Lawrence Katz
references.desc:
The Race between Education and
        Technology (2008)
references.connection:
US wage inequality as failure of educational
        investment; Piketty accepts as partial
        explanation

references.name: Gabriel Zucman
references.connection:
Core collaborator on wealth data; later
        extended to offshore tax evasion analysis

references.name: Honoré de Balzac
references.connection:
Literary documentary of Belle Époque wealth
        distribution; Vautrin's lesson on inheritance
        vs. work

references.name: Jane Austen
references.connection:
Precise documentation of 19th-century English
        wealth structures and the social mathematics
        of inheritance

references.name: Robert Gordon
references.connection:
Predicts US per capita growth below 0.5%
        2050–2100; supports Piketty's slow-growth
        scenario

references.name: John Rawls
references.connection:
Difference principle; philosophical foundation
        for the modern social state's redistributive
        logic

references.name: Amartya Sen
references.connection:
Alternative philosophical basis for social
        rights; convergent conclusions with Rawls
        from different premises

references.name: Irving Fisher
references.connection:
First major American economist to call
        concentration "undemocratic"; proposed estate
        taxes reaching 100%

connections.title: The Rise and Fall of American Growth
connections.author: Robert J. Gordon
